extra_vocab.en: the act of giving something to someone for review, or the thing that is given
extra_vocab.note: 在政策或公告中，submissions 指員工或廠商繳交的報告、表單或提案；late submissions 就是逾期繳交的文件，是會被處罰的對象。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: submission 表示「提交這件事」時不可數；指「一份提交的文件」時可數（a submission / submissions）。

example.en: A late submission will not be reviewed by the committee.
example.zh: 逾期繳交的文件不會由委員會審查。

example.en: The submission deadline for the proposal is next Friday at noon.
example.zh: 提案的提交截止時間是下週五中午。

example.en: Online submission saves time because no paper forms are needed.
example.zh: 線上提交可以節省時間，因為不需要紙本表單。

example.en: Please fill out the submission form before uploading your files.
example.zh: 請在上傳檔案前先填寫提交表單。

examples.en: As noted in my email, the policy penalizes late submissions.
examples.zh: 如我在電子郵件中所說，這項政策會處罰逾期繳交。

examples.en: We received three submissions before the closing date.
examples.zh: 截止日之前我們收到了三份提交的文件。

examples.en: Reviewing all the submissions will take our team two full days.
examples.zh: 審查所有提交的文件會花我們團隊整整兩天。

confusable.diff: admission 是「入場、入場費」或「承認」；submission 是「提交」，兩者字尾都是 -mission，容易看錯。

example.en: Admission is free, but proposal submission closes on Friday.
example.zh: 入場免費，但提案的提交會在星期五截止。

confusable.diff: permission 是「許可」；submission 是「提交」，字尾相同，意思無關。

example.en: You need written permission before making your submission to the board.
example.zh: 向董事會提交文件之前，你需要取得書面許可。

example.en: The deadline for the budget report was moved to Monday.
example.zh: 預算報告的截止期限改到星期一。

example.en: Your application will be reviewed within five working days.
example.zh: 你的申請會在五個工作天內審查。

derived.link: submission 的詞幹；sub-（在下）+ mit（送），把東西送上去，像 permit、commit
re-（再）+ submit，重新提交，像 rewrite、rebuild

senses.en: the act of giving a document to someone for review
senses.distinguish: 前面常加 the，後面接 of 加文件名稱，指「提交這件事」。

example.en: The submission of expense reports is due on the fifth.
example.zh: 費用報告的提交期限是五號。

senses.en: a document or a plan that someone gives to others for review
senses.distinguish: 可數，常用 each / every submission，指一份份被繳交的東西。

example.en: Each submission must include a cover page and a budget.
example.zh: 每一份提交的文件都必須附上封面和預算。

extra_vocab.en: telling the truth and not trying to cheat
extra_vocab.note: 在 honest mistake 裡，honest 指「出於無心、沒有惡意」，不是「誠實的錯誤」；公司常用它說明無心之過不會被處罰。

example.en: The manager said an honest mistake would not be punished.
example.zh: 經理說，無心之過不會受到處罰。

example.en: Please give me your honest opinion of the new design.
example.zh: 請坦白告訴我你對新設計的看法。

example.en: It is better to be honest with clients about delays.
example.zh: 對客戶坦白說明延誤比較好。

examples.en: We appreciate honest feedback from every member of the team.
examples.zh: 我們很感謝團隊每位成員提出坦白的意見回饋。

examples.en: To be honest, the delivery will probably take another week.
examples.zh: 老實說，交貨可能還要再一週。

examples.en: She gave an honest answer about the problems with the schedule.
examples.zh: 她坦白回答了關於時程的問題。

similar.diff: truthful 強調說的話符合事實；honest 則形容一個人的品格，也能指沒有惡意。

example.en: Her truthful report helped the team fix the problem quickly.
example.zh: 她據實的報告幫助團隊很快解決了問題。

similar.diff: frank 是坦率直說，有時不太客氣；honest 比較中性，著重不說謊。

example.en: He was frank about the risks during the budget meeting.
example.zh: 他在預算會議上坦率說出了風險。

confusable.diff: honorable 是「光榮的、值得尊敬的」；honest 是「誠實的」，兩字同字根 honor，但意思不同。

example.en: The honest clerk returned the money, which was an honorable thing to do.
example.zh: 這位誠實的店員把錢還了回去，這是很值得敬重的舉動。

example.en: We need a reliable supplier who delivers on time.
example.zh: 我們需要一家準時交貨、值得信賴的供應商。

example.en: The firm is known as a trustworthy partner in the industry.
example.zh: 這家公司在業界以值得信賴的夥伴聞名。

example.en: The contract offers a fair price for both sides.
example.zh: 這份合約對雙方都提供了合理的價格。

derived.link: honest + -y，名詞字尾（誠實的特質），像 difficult → difficulty
dis-（不）+ honest，加 dis- 表示相反，像 disagree、dislike
dishonest + -y 的名詞形，指不誠實的行為

senses.en: telling the truth and not cheating

example.en: The vendor is honest and always shows the real costs.
example.zh: 這家廠商很誠實，總是列出真正的成本。

senses.distinguish: 和 opinion、answer、feedback 連用時，指「坦白說出真實想法」。

example.en: I would like your honest opinion before we sign the deal.
example.zh: 簽約前我想聽聽你坦白的看法。

senses.en: done without wanting to cause harm
senses.distinguish: 只和 mistake、error 這類字連用，表示「出於無心、沒有惡意」。

example.en: It was an honest mistake, and the bank corrected the amount.
example.zh: 這是無心之過，銀行已更正金額。

extra_vocab.en: a meeting or report where a manager judges how well an employee works
extra_vocab.note: 公司定期由主管評估員工工作表現的面談或報告，常和加薪、升遷有關；句中說明無心之過不會影響考績。
extra_vocab.pattern: have / conduct a performance review + (of / for) + 人
extra_vocab.grammar_note: review 在這裡是可數名詞（a performance review）；主管「進行考績」用 conduct 或 do，員工「接受考績」用 have 或 get。

examples.en: The manager explained that honest mistakes will not affect your performance review.
examples.zh: 經理說明，無心之過不會影響你的考績。

examples.en: Your annual performance review is scheduled for Tuesday at ten o'clock.
examples.zh: 你的年度考績面談安排在星期二十點。

examples.en: Good attendance and teamwork will help you get a strong performance review.
examples.zh: 良好的出勤和團隊合作會幫助你拿到不錯的考績。

similar.diff: evaluation 更強調依標準打分數或下評語；performance review 則可以只是一次談話與回顧。

example.en: Each employee receives a performance evaluation every six months.
example.zh: 每位員工每六個月會接受一次績效評估。

similar.diff: appraisal 語氣較正式，常見於人資制度與書面表格。

example.en: The performance appraisal form must be signed by both sides.
example.zh: 績效考核表必須由雙方簽名。

confusable.diff: peer review 是同事或同行互相審查；performance review 是由主管評估員工。

example.en: A peer review gives colleagues a chance to comment on your work.
example.zh: 同儕審查讓同事有機會對你的工作提出意見。

extra_vocab.en: an effort to do something, often something difficult
extra_vocab.note: 在這句稽核結果裡，attempt to hide money 指「隱瞞款項的企圖」，帶有負面語氣；名詞 attempt 後面通常接 to + 動詞。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: attempt 當動詞後面接 to + 原形（attempt to fix），不接 V-ing；名詞用 an attempt to + 原形，或 an attempt at + 名詞。

example.en: Several attempts to reach the supplier by phone failed.
example.zh: 好幾次打電話聯絡供應商都失敗了。

example.en: He attempts to answer every customer email within an hour.
example.zh: 他試著在一小時內回覆每一封客戶來信。

example.en: The team attempted to fix the error before the demonstration.
example.zh: 團隊試著在展示前修正這個錯誤。

example.en: She is attempting to reduce costs without cutting staff.
example.zh: 她正試著在不裁員的情況下降低成本。

example.en: We will make an attempt to contact the client again today.
example.zh: 我們今天會再試著聯絡客戶一次。

example.en: The firm cut prices in an attempt to win new customers.
example.zh: 公司降價，試圖爭取新客戶。

example.en: Our first attempt to log in to the system failed.
example.zh: 我們第一次嘗試登入系統時失敗了。

examples.en: The auditor found only honest mistakes, not any attempt to hide money.
examples.zh: 稽核員只發現無心的錯誤，沒有任何隱瞞款項的企圖。

examples.en: This is our last attempt to settle the matter without a lawyer.
examples.zh: 這是我們不透過律師解決此事的最後一次嘗試。

examples.en: The system blocked an attempt to enter the account with a wrong password.
examples.zh: 系統擋下了一次用錯誤密碼進入帳戶的企圖。

similar.diff: try 是最口語、最常用的說法；attempt 語氣較正式，常用於書面或報告。

example.en: We will try to finish the report before the meeting.
example.zh: 我們會試著在會議前完成報告。

similar.diff: effort 強調花了多少力氣；attempt 強調「試了一次」這個動作，結果可能失敗。

example.en: Their effort to cut costs saved the company thousands of dollars.
example.zh: 他們降低成本的努力為公司省下數千美元。

confusable.diff: tempt 是「誘惑、吸引」，字形包含在 attempt 裡面，發音也很像，但意思不同。

example.en: A generous bonus might tempt staff to attempt harder tasks.
example.zh: 豐厚的獎金可能吸引員工去嘗試更困難的任務。

confusable.diff: attend 是「出席、參加」；attempt 是「嘗試」，兩字都以 at- 開頭且重音相同。

example.en: Please attend the training session and attempt every practice question.
example.zh: 請參加培訓課程，並嘗試每一道練習題。

example.en: The software is free during a thirty-day trial.
example.zh: 這套軟體在三十天試用期間是免費的。

example.en: Their first attempt at selling online brought in few orders.
example.zh: 他們第一次嘗試線上銷售，訂單很少。

example.en: Do not attempt to repair the machine without training.
example.zh: 沒有受過訓練，請不要試圖自行修理這台機器。

example.en: The second attempt succeeded after the engineers fixed the settings.
example.zh: 工程師修正設定後，第二次嘗試成功了。

senses.en: an effort to do something wrong or against the rules
senses.distinguish: 後面接 steal、hide、cheat 等負面動詞時，指「企圖」，語氣是負面的。

example.en: The bank reported an attempt to steal customer data last night.
example.zh: 銀行通報昨晚有人企圖竊取客戶資料。

extra_vocab.zh: 粗心的錯誤、疏忽造成的錯誤
extra_vocab.en: mistakes caused by not paying enough attention
extra_vocab.note: 和 honest mistakes 不同，careless mistakes 指因為不夠小心而犯的錯，在稽核或考績情境中可能被要求改善。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「犯錯」用 make a mistake，不用 do；careless 是形容詞，修飾名詞 mistakes，不要寫成 carelessly mistakes。

examples.en: Careless mistakes in the invoice caused a two-week payment delay.
examples.zh: 發票上的粗心錯誤造成了兩週的付款延遲。

examples.en: Please check your figures twice to avoid careless mistakes.
examples.zh: 請把數字檢查兩次，避免粗心的錯誤。

examples.en: Most careless mistakes happen when staff work too quickly.
examples.zh: 大多數粗心的錯誤都發生在員工工作太快的時候。

similar.diff: silly mistakes 比較口語，帶有「本來不該犯」的語氣。

example.en: We made a few silly mistakes in the first draft.
example.zh: 我們在初稿中犯了幾個不該犯的小錯。

similar.diff: avoidable errors 較正式，強調這些錯誤本來可以避免，常用於報告。

example.en: Most of the avoidable errors came from missing data entry checks.
example.zh: 大部分可避免的錯誤來自缺少資料輸入的檢查。

confusable.diff: honest mistake 是無心、沒有惡意的錯；careless mistakes 是因為不夠注意而犯的錯，責任較重。

example.en: An honest mistake is forgiven, but careless mistakes need extra training.
example.zh: 無心之過可以被原諒，但粗心的錯誤需要額外訓練。

confusable.diff: carefree 是「無憂無慮的」，與 careless 同字根 care，但不是「粗心」。

example.en: A carefree attitude toward deadlines can lead to careless mistakes.
example.zh: 對截止日期漫不在乎的態度可能導致粗心的錯誤。

extra_vocab.zh: 無心之過、非故意的錯誤
extra_vocab.en: a mistake made without wanting to cause trouble
extra_vocab.note: 在客服、財務或法務情境中，用來強調錯誤不是故意的，常用來請對方諒解。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: innocent 以母音開頭，冠詞要用 an（an innocent mistake），不是 a。

examples.en: The extra charge was an innocent mistake, and we will refund it.
examples.zh: 多收的費用是無心之過，我們會退款。

examples.en: I hope you can see that this was only an innocent mistake.
examples.zh: 希望你能理解這只是一個無心的錯誤。

examples.en: The accountant said the wrong figure was an innocent mistake.
examples.zh: 會計師說，那個錯誤的數字是無心之過。

similar.diff: 意思幾乎相同，honest mistake 在職場公告和規定中更常見。

example.en: The audit showed it was an honest mistake, not a plan to cheat.
example.zh: 稽核顯示這是無心之過，不是蓄意欺騙。

similar.diff: unintentional error 語氣較正式，常見於書面報告。

example.en: The unintentional error in the report was corrected the same day.
example.zh: 報告中的無心錯誤在當天就更正了。

extra_vocab.en: a mistake made by a person, not by a machine
extra_vocab.note: 事故報告與客服信常見，用來說明問題是人的操作失誤，而不是系統或機器故障；語氣客觀，有時也用來淡化責任。
extra_vocab.pattern: N + was caused by + human error
extra_vocab.grammar_note: human error 通常是不可數名詞，不加 a 或 s，例如 due to human error。

examples.en: The delay was caused by human error, not by a system failure.
examples.zh: 這次延誤是人為疏失造成的，不是系統故障。

examples.en: Training can reduce human error in the packing department.
examples.zh: 訓練可以減少包裝部門的人為疏失。

examples.en: Most data entry problems are due to human error.
examples.zh: 大多數資料輸入的問題都是人為疏失造成的。

similar.diff: operator error 指操作機器或系統的人員失誤，比 human error 更具體。

example.en: The report named operator error as the cause of the shutdown.
example.zh: 報告指出操作人員的失誤是停機的原因。

similar.diff: user error 指使用者（客戶）的操作錯誤，客服情境很常見。

example.en: The technician said the problem was user error, not a defect.
example.zh: 技術人員說問題出在使用者操作錯誤，不是產品瑕疵。

confusable.diff: system error 是軟體或機器本身的錯誤；human error 是人造成的錯誤。

example.en: A system error, not human error, caused the double billing.
example.zh: 重複收費是系統錯誤造成的，不是人為疏失。

extra_vocab.en: something that is wrong in a document, a number, or a system
extra_vocab.note: 比 mistake 正式，常指帳目、資料或系統中的錯誤；在報告、客服信和技術訊息中很常見。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: error 是可數名詞（an error / errors）；in error 表示「錯誤地、誤」，前面不加 an。

example.en: The audit found several errors in the monthly sales figures.
example.zh: 稽核在每月銷售數字中發現了幾處錯誤。

example.en: It is easy to make an error when you enter data late.
example.zh: 很晚才輸入資料時很容易出錯。

example.en: An error message appeared as soon as I tried to log in.
example.zh: 我一試著登入，就跳出錯誤訊息。

example.en: The survey has a margin of error of three percent.
example.zh: 這項調查的誤差範圍是百分之三。

example.en: We must correct an error in the delivery address today.
example.zh: 我們今天必須更正送貨地址上的一個錯誤。

examples.en: The accountant found an error in the total on the second page.
examples.zh: 會計師在第二頁的總額中發現了一個錯誤。

examples.en: We apologize for the billing error and have fixed your account.
examples.zh: 我們為帳單錯誤致歉，並已修正您的帳戶。

examples.en: The software showed an error after the latest update was installed.
examples.zh: 安裝最新更新後，軟體出現了錯誤。

similar.diff: mistake 較口語，多指人犯的錯；error 較正式，也能指機器、資料或系統的錯。

example.en: I made a mistake on the order form, so I will resubmit it.
example.zh: 我在訂購單上填錯了，所以我會重新提交。

similar.diff: inaccuracy 強調內容不準確、和事實有出入；error 是更廣泛的錯誤。

example.en: The inaccuracy in the report was caused by old data.
example.zh: 報告中的不準確是舊資料造成的。

confusable.diff: terror 是「恐懼」，字尾 -rror 與 error 相同，發音也只差第一個音，容易看錯或聽混。

example.en: Fear of making an error is not the same as real terror.
example.zh: 害怕犯錯和真正的恐懼是不同的。

confusable.diff: mirror 是「鏡子、鏡像」，字尾 -rror 與 error 相同，但意思不同。

example.en: The same error appears on the main site and the mirror site.
example.zh: 同樣的錯誤出現在主網站和鏡像網站上。

example.en: Engineers fixed the bug that caused the system to crash.
example.zh: 工程師修正了造成系統當機的程式錯誤。

example.en: Each product is checked carefully for any defect before shipping.
example.zh: 每件產品出貨前都會仔細檢查有沒有瑕疵。

example.en: The report says the fault lies with the old equipment.
example.zh: 報告指出問題出在舊設備上。

derived.link: 與 error 同字根 err（犯錯）；-ous 是形容詞字尾，像 serious、famous

senses.en: something that is wrong in a document, a number, or a system

example.en: A small error in the address sent the package to the wrong city.
example.zh: 地址上的一個小錯誤讓包裹被送到錯的城市。

senses.en: the small difference between a measured number and the real number
senses.distinguish: 和 measurement、margin、rate 等字連用時，指數字上的誤差。

example.en: The measurement error was less than one millimeter.
example.zh: 測量誤差小於一公釐。
